<DESCRIPTION>
Cooperate initially and forgive a single opponent defection, allowing recovery against opponents that make an early test move. Switch permanently to defection after repeated evidence of exploitation.
</DESCRIPTION>

<CODE>
```python

def policy(own_history, opponent_history):
    return 0 if opponent_history.count(1) < 2 else 1
```
